question: Describe the conditions under which periods of suspension can be counted for qualifying service.
Define 'Emoluments' and 'Average emoluments' for the purpose of pension. For what type of pension benefits does emoluments include D.A?
State and explain in brief any five classes of pension.
What is the minimun length of qualifying service required to receive monthly pension? How is the amount of pension determined?
What is the minimun length of qualifying service required to receive Retirement Gratuity? How is the amount determined?
What are the conditions under which Retirement/Death Gratuity lapses to the Government? What is the Certificate required to be produced to receive Gratuity in such cases?

What is the rate of family pension payable to the family of a deceased Government servant, where the Government servant dies while in service (a) after completion of one year continuous service but less than seven years continuous service. (b) after completion of seven years continuous service. How long can the higher rate of Family pension be paid?

A Government servant is habitually late for office, given to leaving office early and intoxication during office hours, and also believed to be in the habit of taking home items of office stationery for his personal use. State and write down the Rule and Clauses of the CCS(Conduct Rules), 1964 under which you will frame charges against him.
Write three points on what actions constitute a 'strike' as enumerated by GID (2) under Rule 7(ii) of the CCS (Conduct Rules), 1964.

What are the limitations on values of gifts that can be received by Government servants on the occasions of weddings, anniversaries, funerals etc. in excess of which report to the Government is necessary as stipulated by Rule 13 of the CCS (Conduct Rules), 1964?
What are the minor penalties that can be imposed on a Government servant under the CCS(CCA) Rules? Explain, in your own words, the difference between 'Censure' and 'Warning'.
What are the circumstances under which a Government servant may be placed under suspension? When is an order of suspension to be reviewed?

Answer the following in brief. (a) Can major penalty proceedings end in the imposition of minor penalty? If so, how is the period of suspension to be treated? (b) Can an accused Government servant under Inquiry take the help of a lawyer as Defense Assistant? If so, under what circumstances?
Who are the members of State Security Commission? How is the expenses on official business in respect of independent members treated and what is the term of the office independent members?

Section 128, 129 and 131 of the Mizoram Police Act, 2011 provide conditions for issue of lawful orders in the streets and public places. How will the police treat person breaching the order issued under the above section of the Acts and what punishment will the court impose on conviction of person who violated the orders?
Who are the appellate authorities on any order of punishment passed against police officer for misconducts under Section 91 of the Mizoram Police Act, 2011 or any rules made under the Act?
Write any one of the role, functions and duties of the Police as provided in Section 40 of the Mizoram Police Act, 2011.
